After running out 1st test of CAR on BEQ CL's Justin, we have noticed the CAR is hitting the Knife flaps.  Maintenance is investigating to why it is hitting.

Due to caramels length when the piece transitions from first drum (pick up the piece from the width) into the second drum (grab the piece from the length) once the gripper closes because the length is larger, the caramel gets pinched, so in the next transition from second drum to third where it folds the wrap, the pinched caramel is hitting there, this can cause parts to bent, and then when 3rd drum try to release the pinched caramel it gots stuck hitting the discharge belt.

As it is right now we are limited on the size of the caramel that we can run. 

We are trying to find the best settings to be in weight range but it will be in the lower side.
Charity Young Curt Willis Justin Garner

Based on the information obtained from the Kitchen operator and the supervisor, there is no identified risk to the Hershey’s Caramel production from 1st shift. The broken gasket was found in the piping that goes to the Succotherm when producing caramel in barrels. This is an independent pipe and is not the line that goes to the drums.


However, after the pipe is cleaned, we will inspect the area to determine if we can locate any missing pieces of the gasket. At this time, we cannot determine when or how the gasket may have broken.


Any additional updates or findings will be communicated through this chat.

According to the explanation I have, the valve gasket that broke goes towards the Sucrotherm, not the Conbar. Furthermore, the gasket broke at 2:20 pm, the line was shut down, and maintenance acted immediately. On another note, I'm asking if they checked the barrel where the Sucrotherm is draining to see if the missing part fell in there. There are two barrels. Angelica Perez  Charity Young

In the case of this valve and gasket when there is a tear or rip, there are immediate signs that we’ll see with the equipment. 

The gasket keeps the flow of the volume consistent, once it tears, a new leak path is created. 
This lowers resistance, increases the volume being outputted. 

What we observed on the operation side: 

Leak on the drain valve at the end of the succotherm.

Caramel dropping slower at the Conbar.
